body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Syngene International (SYNGENE). Probability 0.55 (naive sector base rate 0.56) that: Syngene International (SYNGENE) FY27 EBITDA margin excluding forex/hedge loss >= 23.7% (mid-20s low end 24% less 0.3 pp). Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.562 (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'margin' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=32); SAC -0.065 x w 0.130 (N=3) -> P_cred = 0.55. Evidence: call of 2026-07-30: "we should be able to hold on to the guidance of mid-20s" (Q1FY27); Q2FY27: "no change in the EBITDA guidance ... excluding the forex loss at mid-20". Resolution: YES if the company-reported FY27 EBITDA margin before forex/hedge losses >= 23.7%. Source: company Q3/Q4 FY27 filings, presentations and call transcripts (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-30; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.562 (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'margin' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=32); SAC -0.065 x w 0.130 (N=3) -> P_cred = 0.55
data.adjustment_rule: P_cred = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC, 0.05, 0.95); SAC = mean(y - p0(group)) over the company's resolved past promises (strict: delivered=1, else 0); N<3 -> P_cred = p0. P_base = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = leave-one-out strict delivery rate of Healthcare peers in group 'margin' (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'margin' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=32). No company-specific information.
data.promise_quote: "we should be able to hold on to the guidance of mid-20s" (Q1FY27); Q2FY27: "no change in the EBITDA guidance ... excluding the forex loss at mid-20"
data.resolution_rule: YES if the company-reported FY27 EBITDA margin before forex/hedge losses >= 23.7%.

title: Paper call: Syngene International (SYNGENE) FY27 EBITDA margin excluding forex/hedge loss >= 23.7% (mid-20s low end 24% less 0.3 pp)
